pages.title: Elf on the Shelf Sitting on a Bookshelf Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Elf on the Shelf sitting between rows of books, with a pointed hat and soft shoes dangling over the edge.

pages.title: Girl Elf on the Shelf in a Skirt Coloring Page
pages.description: A girl Elf on the Shelf stands with her mittens on her hips in this printable coloring page featuring a pleated skirt and curled shoes.

pages.title: Boy Elf on the Shelf Holding a Bell Coloring Page
pages.description: The boy Elf on the Shelf lifts a jingle bell by its loop in this printable coloring page, with his curled shoes hanging beneath the shelf.

pages.title: Boy and Girl Elves on the Shelf Coloring Page
pages.description: A boy and girl elf sit side by side with their feet dangling in this printable coloring page, where a hat bow and skirt distinguish the girl.

pages.title: Easy Elf on the Shelf Waving Hello Coloring Page
pages.description: One raised mitten, a pom-pom hat, and broad outlines make this printable coloring page of the Elf on the Shelf waving from a ledge easy to color.

pages.title: Easy Girl Elf on the Shelf Holding a Star Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, the girl Elf on the Shelf holds a large five-pointed star against her dress, with pigtails visible below her hat.

pages.title: Cute Elf on the Shelf Snuggles in a Mitten Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Elf on the Shelf snug inside an oversized mitten, resting both hands on the ribbed cuff beneath his pointed hat.

pages.title: Baby Elf on the Shelf in a Cradle Coloring Page
pages.description: A baby elf peeks over a rocking cradle in this printable coloring page, with tiny fingers curled over the rim and a pillow behind the pointed ears.

pages.title: Funny Elf on the Shelf in a Marshmallow Bath Coloring Page
pages.description: The Elf on the Shelf holds up a marshmallow in this printable coloring page, with the rest of the plump marshmallows piled high in a bowl.

pages.title: Elf on the Shelf Hiding in a Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: An elf parts the branches of a Christmas tree in this printable coloring page filled with large round ornaments, a star topper, and a small pot.

pages.title: Elf on the Shelf with Santa Claus in a Sleigh Coloring Page
pages.description: Santa and the Elf on the Shelf share a sleigh with curling runners and a stack of ribboned presents behind them in this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Elf on the Shelf Reading with a Child Coloring Page
pages.description: An elf and a child share an open picture book on the couch in this printable coloring page, with a star and a cloud on its pages.

pages.title: Elf on the Shelf Holds an "I'm Back" Sign Coloring Page
pages.description: With curled shoes hanging from a shelf, the Elf on the Shelf holds a big I’m Back sign in this printable coloring page for the elf’s return.

pages.title: Elf on the Shelf Riding a Reindeer Coloring Page
pages.description: The Elf on the Shelf holds the reins of a prancing reindeer in this printable coloring page, with branching antlers and a bell below its neck.

pages.title: Elf Pets Reindeer Wearing a Bell Coloring Page
pages.description: An Elf Pets reindeer wears a jingle bell beneath a bow in this printable coloring page, with branching antlers and a small tufted tail.

pages.title: Elf Pets Saint Bernard with a Barrel Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows an Elf Pets Saint Bernard sitting with a barrel on its collar, floppy ears beside its face, and paws out front.

pages.title: Elf Pets Arctic Fox Cub in the Snow Coloring Page
pages.description: On this printable coloring page, the Elf Pets Arctic Fox cub sits in the snow with a curled tail, a snowflake charm, and flakes floating nearby.

pages.title: Chippey the Scout Elf Holding a Snowflake Coloring Page
pages.description: Chippey the Scout Elf holds a large six-pointed snowflake in this printable coloring page, framed by his bent cap, pointed collar, and round mittens.

pages.title: Elf on the Shelf Peeking Out of a Stocking Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling Elf on the Shelf peeks from a hanging stocking in this printable coloring page, gripping the ribbed cuff above a large star.

pages.title: Elf on the Shelf Holding a Candy Cane Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Elf on the Shelf sitting on a narrow shelf with a striped candy cane, dangling boots, and evergreen sprigs.

pages.title: Elf on the Shelf on a Candy Cane Zipline Coloring Page
pages.description: The Elf on the Shelf hangs from a candy cane hooked over a zipline in this printable coloring page, with tree-shaped ornaments at either end.

pages.title: Elf on the Shelf Tangled in Christmas Lights Coloring Page
pages.description: A string of Christmas lights loops around the surprised Elf on the Shelf in this printable coloring page, with one mitten lifting the cord.

pages.title: Elf on the Shelf Popping Out of a Gift Box Coloring Page
pages.description: The Elf on the Shelf pops up through an open gift box in this printable coloring page, with both mittens on the rim above an oversized bow.

pages.title: Elf on the Shelf Wrapping a Christmas Present Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, the Elf on the Shelf pulls ribbon around a square Christmas present beside a roll of wrapping paper on the table.

pages.title: Elf on the Shelf Baking Christmas Cookies Coloring Page
pages.description: The Elf on the Shelf presses a star cutter into cookie dough in this printable coloring page, beside a rolling pin and a tray of Christmas cookies.

pages.title: Elf on the Shelf Decorates a Gingerbread House Coloring Page
pages.description: The Elf on the Shelf pipes icing onto a gingerbread roof in this printable coloring page, beside a round candy window and striped corner posts.

pages.title: Elf on the Shelf Building a Snowman Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, the Elf on the Shelf sets a snowman’s head in place, with its carrot nose and three buttons outlined for coloring.

pages.title: Elf on the Shelf Sipping Hot Cocoa Coloring Page
pages.description: Steam curls above the mug as the Elf on the Shelf sips hot cocoa on a bench in this printable coloring page, with both mittens around the cup.

pages.title: Elf on the Shelf Riding a Toy Train Coloring Page
pages.description: The Elf on the Shelf waves from a toy locomotive in this printable coloring page, with a wagon full of ribboned gifts following along the track.

pages.title: Elf on the Shelf Making a Flour Snow Angel Coloring Page
pages.description: With boots and mittens spread wide, the Elf on the Shelf makes a flour snow angel beside a tipped cup in this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Elf on the Shelf Fishing in the Sink Coloring Page
pages.description: A tiny fishing rod bends over the kitchen sink in this printable coloring page, where the Elf on the Shelf drops a line beside a fish.

pages.title: Elf on the Shelf Inside a Snow Globe Coloring Page
pages.description: The Elf on the Shelf sits cross-legged inside a snow globe in this printable coloring page, surrounded by three snowflakes, snowy hills, and a fir tree.
